name: SaunaLife Model EE6G 4-Person Ergo Elegance Series Sauna Barrel
description: SaunaLife Model EE6G Ergo Elegance Series Sauna Barrel 63" L x 91" D Glass Front, 4-Person Constructed by sauna enthusiasts, the SaunaLife EE6G is the epitome of spaciousness, comfort, durability, and affordability in the form of a sleek outdoor sauna barrel. It stands out as the premier choice for sauna enthusiasts, offering unparalleled quality and value. Ergonomics – Barrel Sauna Comfort Expertly designed for optimal comfort, the SaunaLife Model EE6G Sauna Barrel Ergo Elegance Series can accommodate up to four bathers. The contoured bench and arched backrest have been thoughtfully crafted for superior ergonomics, ensuring a supremely comfortable experience. With an elevated seating position and lower footrest, this sauna offers unparalleled comfort compared to other barrel saunas. The SaunaLife Model EE6G offers a spacious interior diameter of 7’3” that allows for comfortable standing without crouching. The larger diameter also allows for ergonomically contoured and formfitting seating. With a true lumbar support and natural seating position, the arched backrest provides a comfortable experience. The smooth and luxurious seating is made from 50% thicker Thermo-Aspen, a knot-free wood perfect for high heat and providing comfort against the skin. Full-Glass Facade The sauna's refreshing interior is illuminated by a magnificent 8mm tempered full glass front wall, while also emphasizing the beauty of the exterior spruce staves. These staves are strengthened, stabilized, and protected from the elements with thermal enhancements, ensuring lifelong durability. A perfectly fitting floor guarantees stable and secure footing at all times. Durability – A lifetime of outdoor bathing pleasure SaunaLife uses "Thermo-Spruce" wood, treated with pressurized heat and steam for increased durability and thermal resistance (R-value), lasting up to 2 times longer than Cedarwood. Their saunas feature industry-leading 1.65" thick full-length Thermo-Spruce staves, made from chemical-free and eco-friendly wood that maintains its shape, making it perfect for outdoor use. Ingenuity - Engineered to exceed expectations The SaunaLife Model EE6G Sauna Barrel Ergo Elegance Series is an exceptional product with advanced engineering features. It is effortless to assemble and designed to withstand water splashes, making it ideal for any environment. With 1-7/8” wide and 1/8” thick stainless-steel barrel bands, it offers superior compression and stave security. Additionally, its watertight shingle kit, complete with drip rails, ensures excellent management of rainwater and keeps bathers dry in all weather conditions. The SaunaLife EE6G features two floor drains. One is strategically located under the sauna heater for easy water disposal, while the other is situated near the door to accommodate potential cold plunge or pool water accumulation. Illumination – Inside and out SaunaLife's EE6G Sauna Barrel Ergo Elegance Series is equipped with a reliable, heat and water-certified (IP67) white LED lighting system that can be controlled through a Wi-Fi app or a hand-held remote for seamless dimming operations. The dotless design provides an uninterrupted glow, highlighting the natural beauty of the wood and enhancing your sauna experience. Maximize your sauna experience with the E Sconce+ Package, including two outdoor LED wall sconces and an additional interior LED lightbar for optimal lighting. Enhance your sensory experience even further with the E MOOD Chromotherapy Lighting Package, offering an endless array of colors. Beauty – A compliment to almost any outdoor oasis Discover the traditional, expertly crafted SaunaLife EE6G model designed in Northern Europe, where sauna bathing is a natural element of daily living. Experience a lifetime of wellness right in your backyard and embrace the SaunaLife lifestyle! The EE6G Black includes outdoor black paint for customer application after delivery. The paint is recommended to be reapplied annually as needed to maintain the finish. Applying the paint after delivery allows for a smooth, even finish and helps avoid scratches or nicks that can occur during LTL freight shipping. All sales are final for Custom made and Made-to-order products. Refunds & Returns If you need to exchange your product, you may do so. This often varies on a case-by-case basis; please reach out to us if you would like specific information on your brand and/or product. Due to drastically increasing LTL/freight shipping costs, any outright returns will incur a 25% cancellation fee + return shipping costs. If you are replacing the product with something else, we may be able to help you cover some of the costs depending on the product. Seller reserves the right to refuse to refund any deposit or payment or cancel any payment due, and any owing until Seller a) receives the goods b) has inspected the goods and c) in the Seller's discretion, has found the goods to be free of damage. All refunds will be provided within 5 business days once the product has been returned to the warehouse and inspected for damage. Shipping Times We promise to do our best to get your order to you as soon as possible. We provide estimated shipping times on the product pages based upon what our suppliers and freight companies tell us, and those estimated shipping times may change or vary without notice (Due to supply chain issues, the steel mills behind on making metal, the manufacturers delayed because of the mills, the overwhelming demand on shipping, factory/warehouse and dock workers and so on).
